questions.question: Which two diseases have emerged as major killers in Kerala this season, with the state reporting significant cases and deaths as of September 15?

questions.background: Kerala often faces seasonal outbreaks of infectious diseases, influenced by its tropical climate and monsoon patterns. questions.question: A study by the Kerala Forest Research Institute warned that bamboo mass flowering and die-off can push which animal into farmland?
questions.explanation: A study conducted by the Kerala Forest Research Institute has issued a warning that synchronous bamboo mass flowering and subsequent die-off can precipitate an ecological crisis. This phenomenon can lead to the proliferation of invasive weeds, increase wildfire risks, trigger rodent surges, and crucially, compel elephants to venture into farmlands, escalating human-wildlife conflict.
questions.background: Bamboo flowering is a natural, yet infrequent, event where large stands flower simultaneously before dying off. These mass flowering events, occurring after long intervals (e.g., 40-120 years), drastically alter forest ecosystems and can disrupt the food sources of herbivores, particularly elephants, leading them to seek food in human settlements.
questions.examRelevance: Bamboo mass flowering can push elephants into farmland, as per KFRI study.

source.title: Bamboo mass flowering and die-off can trigger ecological crisis and wildlife conflict, study warns
